successfulPercentages = () => {

countResponseTime=from(bucket: "PerfDB")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "requestsRaw")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "responseTime")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["runId"] =~ /${runId_Baseline:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["nodeName"] =~ /${Test_Name:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["requestName"] =~ /${Script_Name:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["requestName"] !~ /#/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["samplerType"] =~ /${samplerType:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["runId"])
  |> count()
  |> toFloat()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "runId"])
  
sumerrorCount=from(bucket: "PerfDB")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "requestsRaw")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "errorCount")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["runId"] =~ /${runId_Baseline:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["nodeName"] =~ /${Test_Name:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["requestName"] =~ /${Script_Name:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["requestName"] !~ /#/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["samplerType"] =~ /${samplerType:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["runId"])  
  |> sum()
  |> toFloat()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "runId"])
  
  return join(
      tables:{countResponseTime:countResponseTime, sumerrorCount:sumerrorCount},
      on:["runId"]
    )
    |> map(fn:(r) => ({
             
             _value: 1.0 - r._value_sumerrorCount / r._value_countResponseTime      
    }))   
   
}
